data: Is the value of the blue line at the end of the graph 1?

The blue line represents the frequencies of the most frequent 100 words in the corpus. The y-axis is logarithmic, meaning each step up represents a tenfold increase in frequency. At the end of the graph, the blue line appears to be at the lowest point on the y-axis, which corresponds to a value of 1. Therefore, the value of the blue line at the end of the graph is indeed 1.
